newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Seven Indonesians dead in bus crash, 20 injured.
newsitem.headline: Seven Indonesians dead in bus crash, 20 injured.

text.p: Seven Indonesians died and 20 were injured when a bus collided with a truck in Riau province on Sumatra island, the Antara news agency reported on Sunday.
Antara quoted police sources as saying the accident happened on Saturday afternoon in Siak Sri Indrapura district. The bus was traveling to Buton from the provincial capital of Pekanbaru.
"Five of the victims died instantly while two others died on the way to the hospital," Antara said. It gave no other details.
